with j as (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders where strategy='Jmmsell10' and action='buy')
select o.market_ticker, string_agg(o.strategy||':q'||o.quantity||':'||o.status||'@'||to_char(o.created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' | ' order by o.created_at) orders,
 (select sum(f.quantity) from fills f join live_orders o2 on o2.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o2.market_ticker=o.market_ticker and o2.action='buy') filled_all_tags
from live_orders o join j using(market_ticker) where o.action='buy' group by o.market_ticker having count(distinct o.strategy)>1
